evals.prompt: Review PR https://github.com/example-org/example-service/pull/2 — an ADR changed the data-at-rest model. Check the docs are consistent.
evals.expected_output: A drift report that flags every doc still describing the pre-ADR model (README, OpenAPI descriptions, code comments) as superseded-model drift, each quoting the doc line and naming the ADR that retired it.
assertions: docs-drift-2.json exists and is valid JSON
At least one finding has drift_class 'superseded-model'
Each drift finding includes both doc_says and code_says
The ADR index row for the amended ADR is flagged if it doesn't reflect the amendment (adr-index class)

evals.prompt: For PR https://github.com/example-org/example-service/pull/2, does docs/api/index.html still match openapi.yaml after this change?
evals.expected_output: A rendered-lag finding only if a committed rendered artifact exists and still contains a pre-change string; otherwise a note that the render is untracked/regenerated by a hook, with no false hand-edit suggestion.
assertions: No finding proposes hand-editing a generated artifact when a regen hook exists
If index.html is absent/untracked, the report says so rather than flagging a missing edit

evals.prompt: Check the docs for a PR to the $MAC_UI_REF_REPO repo which renames a slot on mac-dialog.
evals.expected_output: Fetches mac-ui's live per-component doc for mac-dialog, then flags any consuming-repo doc that still documents the old slot name as drift.
assertions: The run fetches mac-ui docs via gh api (dynamic), not from skill memory
A drift finding references the mac-dialog component doc as the authority
